sloka: रामचन्द्रमसं दृष्ट्वा ग्रस्तं रावणराहुणा ।प्राजापत्यं च नक्षत्रं रोहिणीं शशिनः प्रियाम् ।। ६.१०३.२९ ।।
transliteration: rāmacandramasaṁ dṛṣṭvā grastaṁ rāvaṇarāhuṇā ।prājāpatyaṁ ca nakṣatraṁ rohiṇīṁ śaśinaḥ priyām ।। 6.103.29 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter having showered a thousand shafts on Rama, of unwearied action, Ravana pierced Matali with shafts.
